_comment: Example project rules for `node watch.mjs --rules watch.rules.example.json`. Copy it and change it to what your own project cares about; nothing in it is checked unless you pass --rules. `commands` are tested against every shell command a watched session runs. `paths` are tested against every file the harness reports as changed, written relative to the session's working directory with forward slashes; a file outside the working directory keeps its absolute path, which is what the first path rule below relies on. `flags` defaults to i; g and y are not accepted. A hit is printed as an [ALERT] line with the message and the command or path.

commands.message: git command that changes the repository or its history
command mentions a credential-looking file or variable
command kills processes by name, which can take down other people's work

paths.message: changed a file outside the session's working directory
